tasks.gr11-development-of-self-t1: Topic: Development of the Self in Society. Cover life roles in family, school and community, personal purpose and meaning, core values, and self-management strategies. Ask Grade 11 learners to analyse how roles change as they mature, map their own life roles, evaluate how values guide decisions, or plan intentional personal growth steps aligned to their strengths and responsibilities.
tasks.gr11-relationships-sexuality-health-t1: Topic: Relationships, Sexuality and Health. Cover healthy and unhealthy relationship patterns, consent in romantic and sexual relationships, reproductive health facts, effective communication in intimate relationships, and responsible decision-making. Ask Grade 11 learners to evaluate relationship scenarios using rights-based and health principles, identify myths about sexuality, or describe communication strategies that promote safe and respectful relationships.
tasks.gr11-study-skills-coping-t1: Topic: Study Skills and Coping Strategies. Cover exam-preparation strategies for the FET phase, workload planning across multiple subjects, sources of academic stress and how to manage them, building resilience, and using available support systems. Ask Grade 11 learners to develop a study plan, identify personal stressors, evaluate coping strategies, or explain how a support network strengthens wellbeing.
tasks.gr11-physical-education-task-1-t1: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 1. Cover principles of fitness development, correct technique and endurance training, the role of flexibility and warm-up or cool-down routines, and designing a personal physical activity programme. Ask Grade 11 learners to record fitness data, describe components of a fitness programme, evaluate participation consistency, or explain how regular activity supports mental and physical health.
